# postgres:18-alpine / 18 が求める位置に named volume を置いた場合（#485）
# container CLI 1.2.2 / 2026-08-23
$ cat compose.yaml
services:
  s:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: x
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql
volumes:
  pgdata:
$ opossum up --no-supervisor
Creating network pg18-named-newdir-net
Starting s (postgres:18-alpine)
s.pg18-named-newdir.opossum
$ opossum ps | tail -1   # 見出し行は落としている
s        s.pg18-named-newdir.opossum  postgres:18-alpine  192.168.64.2  -      running
$ opossum logs s | tail -3
2026-08-22 21:09:08.541 UTC [1] LOG:  listening on Unix socket "/var/run/postgresql/.s.PGSQL.5432"
2026-08-22 21:09:08.543 UTC [60] LOG:  database system was shut down at 2026-08-22 21:09:08 UTC
2026-08-22 21:09:08.545 UTC [1] LOG:  database system is ready to accept connections
